part: AXL E EIP IOL8 DI4 M12 6P (2701496)
connector: M12 A-coded 5-pos (ports), M12 D-coded (Ethernet), M12 T-coded (US/UA)
source: Phoenix Contact 2701496 datasheet (EtherNet/IP member of the AXL E IOL8 DI4 family; the PROFINET sheets could not be opened): 'Axioline E EtherNet/IP device in a plastic housing with 8 IO-Link ports and 4 digital inputs'; 'Connection of four IO-Link devices with additional digital input'; 'Connection of four IO-Link actuators with additional power supply'; 'IP65/IP67'; 'Width 60 mm / Height 185 mm / Depth 30.5 mm'. The sheet never says 'class A/B', so which four ports carry UA is not published and port_class is filed as mixed with no per-port split.
